title: Small shift-closed perfect families in set-generated derived subcategories
statement: Let A be a Grothendieck abelian category with Hom and derived-Hom universe v [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Let P be a v-essentially small class in D(A) and Q a replete triangulated full subcategory closed under all v-small coproducts, containing P and minimal with those properties. There exist a type J in universe v and objects S_j in Q such that the family is closed under all integer shifts up to isomorphism, every object of P is isomorphic in D(A) to some S_j, and the family is perfect in Q: for every v-small family of maps f_i:X_i to Y_i in Q, surjectivity of Hom(S_j,f_i) for every i,j implies surjectivity of Hom(S_j,coproduct_i f_i) for every j.

source.place: Well-generation step of det-existence-localizing: Neeman Theorem 0.2; Krause Localization theory Sections 6.3 and 6.8, Theorem 7.2.1 and Corollary 7.2.2.

proof.text: Choose an ambient essentially small replete triangulated perfect class S containing P with the bounded-subcoproduct factorization property.

Put B=S intersect Q. It is replete and triangulated, essentially small since it is contained in S, and contains P. For a map from S to a coproduct of B objects, ambient factorization gives a subcoproduct lying in S; Q contains this subcoproduct because all its summands belong to Q. Thus the factorization object lies in B.

Apply perfectFamily_of_small_hull to S, B, P and Q. The minimality hypothesis is used in that proved theorem to make factorization through B hold for all objects of Q, and it transfers ambient perfectness to the small family of B representatives.

proof_origin.place: Choose the ambient class S, intersect with Q, and apply the proved factorization/localizing-hull construction.

theorem setGeneratedDerived_exists_perfectFamily
    {A : Type u} [Category.{v} A] [Abelian A]
    [IsGrothendieckAbelian.{v} A] [HasDerivedCategory.{v} A]
    (P Q : ObjectProperty (DerivedCategory A))
    [ObjectProperty.EssentiallySmall.{v} P]
    [Q.IsClosedUnderIsomorphisms] [Q.IsTriangulated]
    [∀ I : Type v, Q.IsClosedUnderColimitsOfShape (Discrete I)]
    (hP : P ≤ Q)
    (hminimal : ∀ R : ObjectProperty (DerivedCategory A), P ≤ R →
      R.IsClosedUnderIsomorphisms → R.IsTriangulated →
      (∀ I : Type v, R.IsClosedUnderColimitsOfShape (Discrete I)) → Q ≤ R) :
    ∃ (J : Type v) (S : J → Q.FullSubcategory),
      (∀ (j : J) (n : ℤ), ∃ k, Nonempty (S k ≅ (S j)⟦n⟧)) ∧
      (∀ X (_hX : P X), ∃ j, Nonempty (X ≅ (S j).obj)) ∧
      (∀ (I : Type v) (X Y : I → Q.FullSubcategory) (f : ∀ i, X i ⟶ Y i),
        (∀ i j, Function.Surjective (fun g : S j ⟶ X i ↦ g ≫ f i)) →
        ∀ j, Function.Surjective (fun g : S j ⟶ ∐ X ↦ g ≫ Limits.Sigma.map f))
